abstract: Testicular germ cell tumors are now generally regarded as a highly curable cancer in the majority of cases, even when patients present with advance disease. However that does not imply that researchers and clinicians have become complacent in their efforts to improve our understanding and the treatment outcome of this disease. This is an overview of recent developments in the management of testis cancer.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍は、進行例であっても大多数の症例で高い治癒率が得られる悪性腫瘍と一般に考えられている。しかし、研究者や臨床医が、本疾患の理解と治療成績の改善に向けた努力を怠っているわけではない。本論文は精巣がんの治療の最近の進歩に関する概説である。
